lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Array of high-luminance circular pixel clusters organized into approximately four primary horizontal rows along the visible lateral flank posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal blob rows to form a rectangular grid-like lattice across the mid-lateral section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature extending longitudinally across the dorsal-lateral region, defined by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with high-luminance values superior to a shadowed ventral region.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Discrete high-luminance spots distributed sparsely across the proximal and medial sections of the first dorsal fin's macro-mask.
